visualCharacteristics.structure: grid of centered profile cards (4 per row on desktop, 2 tablet, 1 phone): circular avatar, name heading, uppercase roles line, row of square social icon buttons (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram)

contentPattern: One row per person: cell 1 = avatar image; cell 2 = h3 name, paragraph with roles ('Artist | Photographer | Traveler'), paragraph of social links (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram) with the network name as link text so the block can render icon buttons.
